banner.title: THE LAMMASU PROMOTION - THE GREATER LAMMASU DEF (MM2 print p. 79: the stat block the R808 LMN walk never promoted, the two-voice move settle 15/30 MC B), the QUEUED-DISCOVERY round - the 2 keyless R817 outdoor cells rewire, the registry 809 -> 810, no gap boxes flip - the MM2 arc gap stays 37 closed 0 open
banner.provenance: Round twenty-five of the MM2 arc, the promotion seam round (Curtiss Go call lammasu on the landed R819 index walk; one def promoted, the 2 outdoor cells rewired, the walk-key census 570 -> 572)
banner.sentinel: The pin header stays the print-fidelity record; the def carries the p. 79 stat block, the rewire rides the file patches, and the walk cross-checks the def and the cells live

audit_comment: THE LAMMASU PROMOTION - the queued R817 discovery closed (Curtiss Go call lammasu on the landed R819 index walk): the Lammasu, Greater stat block, MM2 print p. 79 (between the kraken and the land lamprey), the block the R808 LMN walk never promoted, rides as a def. THE DEF: the key lammasu_greater, promoted from the MM2 print (the xpSource mm2_print class), AC 3, HD 12+7 (the book-average 61), MOVE 15/30 (MC: B), 2 attacks for 2-12/2-12, MR 40 percent, level VIII XP 3,950 + 18/hp (the full kill XP 5,048), lawful good, supra-genius, size L (5 feet high at the shoulder), nil treasure and nil lair, psionic nil. THE TWO-VOICE SETTLE: the djvu OCR garbles the move stat (the 5V3Q read) - the 1eonline transcription reads 15/30 MC B and the compendium tables agree (15, Fl 30, B). THE REWIRE: the two R817 outdoor cells (the temperate civilized plains die 2, grid 22; the tropical civilized hills die 20, grid 31) rekey lammasu_greater - the src cells stay 2, the R817 source census unchanged; the walk-key census bumps 570 to 572 (the mm2enco header const and the R817 audit const chain and expression all ride this round as file patches, the LammasuGreaterRows const stays 2). THE REGISTRY: 809 to 810 defs, the MM2 defs 331 to 332; the R817-R819 registry-floor consts stand as their own round snapshots (the >= floor checks stay green). THE DOCTRINE (the p. 79 prose): the greater lammasu travel the Astral and Ethereal Planes at will, become invisible, dimension door and teleport without error (1 at a time, 1 per round), radiate protection from evil for a 20-foot radius with double effect (-4 to evil attacks, +4 on saves), use clerical spells at 5th-level ability (5/4/3/2/1 spells of levels 1-5), the cures double strength based on 1d6+1 (cure light wounds 4-14, cure serious wounds 8-28), 50 percent speak a holy word, the spell-like ability level 12 (as hit dice), dwell with 6 or more ordinary lammasu. NO gap boxes flip this round - the MM2 arc gap stays 37 closed 0 open.
